findings.practical_consequence: A fresh planner cannot produce per-owner budget materialization and valid-budget acceptance steps without inventing the ten authoritative numeric payloads or silently leaving every owner unusable.
evidence: PO-O1-BUDGET requires implementation-source custodians but names no actual custodian, acquisition command, approval authority, or finite decision gate.
O1-CURRENT-BUDGET establishes zero machine-readable owner budgets without ten individual acquisition states.
PO-O1-BUDGET-ACCEPTANCE depends on absent payloads while declaring READY.
findings.evidence_limitation: The package proves values are absent but gives no finite authorized acquisition route.
